tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: Best-price same-chain token swap quote via the KyberSwap aggregator (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc). Includes a disclosed 0.1% integrator fee.

tools.name: swap_build_tx
tools.description: Build an unsigned, non-custodial swap transaction (plus ERC-20 approval tx if needed) for the caller's wallet to sign. Same fee as swap_quote.

tools.name: cow_quote
tools.description: Gasless CoW Protocol market-order quote (ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, bsc; ERC-20 sell tokens). MEV-protected batch auction. Includes the same disclosed 0.1% fee as a CoW partner fee.

tools.name: cow_build_order
tools.description: Build an unsigned CoW market order as EIP-712 typed data (eth_signTypedData_v4) plus the one-time vault-relayer approval tx if needed. No gas for the swap itself.

tools.name: cow_post_order
tools.description: Submit a signed CoW order (from cow_build_order) to the CoW Protocol order book; returns orderUid + explorer link.

tools.name: cow_order_status
tools.description: Status of a CoW order by uid.

tools.name: zerox_quote
tools.description: Same-chain swap quote via the 0x Swap API (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc) with the same disclosed 0.1% Quietwork integrator fee PLUS 0x's own ~0.15% platform fee (Standard plan; returned as zeroExFee), so total fees are higher than on KyberSwap.

tools.name: zerox_build_tx
tools.description: Build an unsigned 0x Swap API (AllowanceHolder) transaction plus ERC-20 approval tx if needed; output goes to sender. Same fees as zerox_quote (0.1% ours + 0x's ~0.15% zeroExFee).

tools.name: velora_quote
tools.description: Same-chain swap quote via Velora (ParaSwap) Market (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc) with the same disclosed 0.1% Quietwork partner fee (Velora keeps 15% of it; no other Velora fee). Often a better price than KyberSwap on some pairs; compare with swap_quote.

tools.name: velora_build_tx
tools.description: Build an unsigned Velora Augustus v6.2 swap tx plus ERC-20 approval tx if needed. Same fee as velora_quote.

tools.name: debridge_quote
tools.description: Cross-chain EVM swap quote via deBridge DLN (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc; e.g. USDC on Base -> ETH on Arbitrum). Includes the same disclosed 0.1% Quietwork affiliate fee PLUS deBridge's own fees (4 bps protocol fee, flat native-coin fee, ~4 bps solver margin, solver gas), all it

tools.name: debridge_build_tx
tools.description: Build an unsigned deBridge DLN cross-chain order transaction (plus ERC-20 approval tx if needed) for sender to sign on the source chain. Same fees as debridge_quote. Returns orderId for tracking.

tools.name: debridge_order_status
tools.description: Status of a deBridge DLN order by orderId.

tools.name: crosschain_rate
tools.description: Cross-chain / cross-asset rate (BTC, XMR, LTC, SOL, ETH, USDC on many networks) via SideShift.ai. Same rate as sideshift.ai.

tools.name: crosschain_create_shift
tools.description: Create a variable-rate SideShift order; returns a deposit address. Funds settle directly to settleAddress (non-custodial for us).

tools.name: shift_status
tools.description: Status of a SideShift order created here.
